title: Association of multiple zeta values with positive knots via Feynman diagrams up to 9 loops
claim: Number of irreducible MZVs of weight n is generated by 1 - x^2 - x^3 = prod (1 - x^n)^{M_n}; for weights 3..9 M_n counts positive knots with n crossings; positive knots up to 15 crossings matched to irreducible MZVs using Feynman diagrams with up to 9 loops (counterterm/period knot-numbers).
loop_order: up to 9 (primitive divergent diagrams; theory not named in the abstract)
theory: scalar field theory diagrams (phi^4-type and related; not supersymmetric)
scheme: pole residues/periods of primitive (subdivergence-free) diagrams are scheme independent (regularization not stated on the abstract page)
red_flags: unrelated to SUSY or to regularization-scheme symmetry questions; listed only because it is a classic 'up to 9 loops' title
notes: Answer to the '9 loops' question, candidate 3 (non-SUSY, 1996).
